doc: The Training Area checklist (Match.train_rows, scripts/match/train_drill.gd): [id, what to do, the action whose key cap the HUD shows beside it ("" for none)]. Never write a key in the text: the HUD prints the live cap in front of each line; {key} puts that same cap inside a line.
rows: Jump, then press jump again in the air to glide
Fuse with your Boki ({key}: open from the start here)
Use your glove (pick one up from the rack first)
Sneak: slower, steadier aim, harder to spot
Sic your Boki at a dummy
Land a combo: shoot a foe your Boki just stunned or rooted
Stagger a big dummy: hit it with an ability while it has a purple ring
Take a found weapon off the ground
Dash off an edge and float back up
Dodge the Strafer's red shot 3 times: dash through it or out of it
